confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Japanese price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe and beer anchors are the firmest; July accommodation rates are the least certain because they vary with demand. USD values assume about 150 yen per US dollar, which was not verified. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 1.4x and 1.3x) because direct knowledge is moderate. FX: the 13 Oct 2026 RBA rate comes from a search-result excerpt of the RBA exchange rates overview page; the page itself was not opened and no 14 Oct 2026 observation was found.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is general Japanese price levels for mid-sized tourist cities near Kyoto and Osaka. Nara accommodation is set somewhat below Kyoto, and restaurant and cafe prices are set close to typical Japanese city levels.
